test_text_to_function: test parsing Python function source text into a structured Function object with name, args, return type, docstring, and body
test_text_to_program: test parsing full Python program source text into a structured Program object with preface and function list
test_roundtrip_function: test converting a Function to string and back to verify lossless roundtrip serialization
test_roundtrip_program: test converting a Program to string and back to verify no extra newlines are added on repeated conversion
test_get_functions_called: test extracting the set of function names called within a given Python code snippet
